item.title: Magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes off coast of Tamarinda
item.description: Magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes off coast of Tamarinda. The quake struck about 40 kilometres offshore at a shallow depth, the geological survey said. At least 12 people were killed and dozens injured, local officials said.

Ceasefire talks between Estovia and Karelan resume
item.description: Ceasefire talks between Estovia and Karelan resume. Mediators said discussions focused on a monitored ceasefire along the border.

item.title: Mirabel wildfires: evacuation orders widen as winds rise
item.description: Mirabel wildfires: evacuation orders widen as winds rise. Strong winds pushed flames toward several towns on Friday. Emergency services said more than 3,000 residents had been told to leave their homes.

item.title: Norvania central bank holds interest rates steady
item.description: Norvania central bank holds interest rates steady. The bank signalled that any future cuts would depend on incoming data.
